D.t: Donald Norcross leads by 30.3 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 87,263 votes; a one point swing is about 1,440 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +22.7 and D +38.0. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
